name: argo-performance-tuning
description: Diagnoses and tunes OpenShift GitOps / Argo CD performance and scalability — reducing unnecessary reconciliation at the source (resource-update ignore rules, resource exclusions, monorepo manifest-cache scoping), repo-server Git and caching behavior, application-controller sharding (static and dynamic) and concurrency, Kubernetes client tuning against managed clusters, self-heal pacing, API-server timeouts, and reconciliation/webhook tuning. Maps symptoms (slow or stuck UI, OOMKilled repo-server, backed-up sync queue, Git provider rate-limiting, sluggish drift detection, "context deadline exceeded" errors, high baseline CPU from status churn or repeated self-heal) to the specific setting that fixes them, for both standalone Argo CD (ConfigMaps + env vars) and the OpenShift GitOps Operator (ArgoCD CR). Use when users report Argo CD or OpenShift GitOps running slowly at scale, hitting OOM, timing out, or ask how to tune, scale, speed up, or reduce resource usage of GitOps reconciliation.
